company.name: Cambridge Mobile Telematics
company.shortDescription: Cambridge Mobile Telematics develops DriveWell, a complete telematics and behavioral analytics solution to improve safety.
company.description: Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) makes roads and drivers safer around the world. CMT pioneered telematics for behavior-based insurance (BBI) and deployed the first solution to provide both traditional vehicle-centric UBI and BBI.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered telematics platform that combines smartphone, vehicle, IoT, dashcam, and other sensor data to assess driving behavior, detect crashes, and support safety and insurance programs.
productsAndServices.name: DriveWell Platform

productsAndServices.description: A telematics risk-measurement solution that analyzes driving behavior and generates insights for insurance pricing, segmentation, risk management, and safer-driver programs.
productsAndServices.name: DriveWell Risk

productsAndServices.description: A combined crash-detection and claims solution that identifies accidents, initiates emergency assistance, and supports faster, more efficient insurance claims handling.
productsAndServices.name: DriveWell Crash & Claims

productsAndServices.description: A driver-engagement solution that uses personalized feedback, safety scores, coaching, and incentives to encourage safer driving and reduce risky behaviors.
productsAndServices.name: DriveWell Engage

productsAndServices.description: A commercial auto telematics solution that combines connected-vehicle data and CMT hardware to provide fleet-wide risk insights for underwriting, pricing, safety management, and insurance.
productsAndServices.name: DriveWell Fleet

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven road-safety analytics platform that helps public-sector organizations identify driving risk, evaluate safety interventions, and prioritize actions to improve roads.
productsAndServices.name: StreetVision

aiResearchSummary.text: Cambridge Mobile Telematics is researching and developing systems for measuring extrinsic crash risk, automating vehicle damage inspection using claims photos, sensor-based detection and alerting of hard braking, vehicle crash prediction using multi-vehicle data, and mobile phone applications for detecting and analyzing driving data. Their work also includes classifying driver behavior, detecting airbag deployment, and scoring driving trips, focusing on telematics and behavioral analytics for vehicle safety.
